item.title: Wiring an AI chatbot into a forum: web 1.0 as a knowledge base
item.description: Years of enthusiast discussions sleep inside forums. Field report from prv-concept.com: an AI chatbot that queries the phpBB database directly, with the anti-hallucination guardrails that make the difference.

item.title: SEO vs GEO: getting cited by ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity
item.description: Ranking on Google is no longer enough: AI assistants pick their sources differently. SEO vs GEO explained by a practitioner, with the concrete nsy.fr case.
